newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: P&O says Wilhelmsen ship hits Sydney wharf.
newsitem.headline: P&O says Wilhelmsen ship hits Sydney wharf.

text.p: P&O Ports, part of the Peninsular and Oriental Steam Navigation Co, said on Sunday that a container crane collapsed onto Sydney's White Bay wharf after it was hit by the cargo ship Toba.
It said no one was injured but the rail-mounted gantry crane was extensively damaged and activity had been disrupted.
An assessment was now being made on whether the crane was salvageable, the company said, noting that a new crane cost about A$10 million.
"In the short term, the incident impacts on the port's productivity capability but every effort will be made to ensure the area is cleared quickly and normal operations resumed," P&O said.
The ship, operated by Norway's Wilhelmsen Lines, had only minor damage and was under the guidance of a pilot at the time of the incident.
